correctness.rationale: The exact published ellipsoid coefficient norm is explicitly fixed. Weighted AM–GM gives precisely gcd(a,b) boundary phase circles and interior zero-freeness. Averaging over the full character-kernel group proves that unrestricted degree-L optimizers lie in the monomial subalgebra, including gcd>1 cases. Weighted Cauchy–Schwarz supplies the attained inverse-Γ-weight sum; Stirling gives the exact κ and three sharp error regimes. Bounded coordinate multipliers establish the cyclicity equivalence. All Borel probability measures on the zero set have forced (an,bn) moments, giving an energy lower bound; full-orbit Haar achieves it. A standalone checker passed independently reconstructed numerical identities. No finite experiment is used as proof.
